name: Truchet Wipe
description: A grid of square tiles, each holding two quarter-circle arcs, links into long winding paths; starting from the middle and spreading outward, the paths are drawn as thin lines of the second clip, then thicken into bands with a dark outline and a soft shadow until they merge over the whole frame. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: cells
params.description: Number of tiles across the frame's height

params.name: outline
params.description: Strength of the dark outline and of the shadow along the bands

params.name: spread
params.description: How much the paths are staggered from the middle outward: 0 draws them all at once
